_comment: CANONICAL source of truth for the Discovery Engine cycle map. The interactive map (docs/cycle-map.html) and the PDF map (docs/discovery-engine-cycle-map.tex) render from this; docs/build_cycle_map.py injects it into the HTML as an inline JSON block; tests/test_cycle_spec_drift.py asserts every referenced function/skill/CLI-verb actually exists in the engine. Public six-stage vocabulary per docs/glossary.md. Edit this file, not the embedded copy in the HTML.

stages.name: Question
stages.meaning: Identify anomalies, discrepancies, gaps, and important unresolved phenomena.
stages.public: Assess knowledge and identify which questions deserve attention.

stages.name: Hypothesize
stages.meaning: Generate competing mechanistic explanations of a phenomenon.
stages.public: Generate alternatives tied to observed surprises.

stages.name: Model
stages.meaning: Represent explanations so they yield explicit, testable consequences.
stages.public: Find, build, wrap, and version executable representations.

stages.name: Experiment
stages.meaning: Design and execute informative computational or empirical tests.
stages.public: Choose interventions, run studies, and collect measured outcomes.

stages.name: Evaluate
stages.meaning: Compare predicted and observed results; assess reliability and support.
stages.public: Assess evidence integrity and competing claims.

stages.name: Synthesize
stages.meaning: Revise the knowledge state, integrate evidence, and expose new questions.
stages.public: Integrate knowledge and start the next round of inquiry.

services.name: Orchestrator
services.responsibilities: Coordinates the cycle, dependencies, permission gates, and execution.

services.name: Reasoner
services.responsibilities: Handles scientific proposal generation and typed AI interaction. Deterministic inference is also reasoning.

services.name: Strategist
services.responsibilities: Ranks scientific opportunities, discriminating studies, and costs (heuristic rankings, not a demonstrably optimal policy).

services.name: Knowledge Base
services.responsibilities: Preserves investigations, studies, model lineage, recorded observations, candidate discoveries, and decisions.

objects.note: A coordinated inquiry with a question, studies, decisions, and acceptance criteria.
A bounded, potentially executable investigation of a narrower question.
General public term; retain behavior_test as the machine contract / subtype.
Split conceptually: measured result vs scientific interpretation. No mechanical schema rename (field-level migration if made canonical).
Explanation and its testable expected consequences.
Interventions, controls, observables, predictions, and decision rule.
A potential scientifically motivated action, often with dependencies and cost.
Signal directing reconsideration of a model vs a hypothesis.
Evidence-backed nomination, not yet a promoted discovery.
A reviewed scientific contribution recorded with provenance.
What scientific conclusions or qualifications changed across cycles.
Union of open scientific and operational needs.
Avoid implying complete epistemic resolution from a boolean closure rule.
A justified disposition of a specific outstanding item.

progression.name: Finding
progression.def: Interpretation supported or challenged by evidence.

frontier_split.scientific: Unresolved biological questions, model disagreement, missing mechanisms, untested explanations, unexplained observations.
frontier_split.operational: Incomplete tests, stale validation, unreadable artifacts, absent visualizations, review decisions, report maintenance.

status_dimensions.name: Completion Status
status_dimensions.question: Have the declared obligations been addressed?

status_dimensions.name: Evidence Status
status_dimensions.question: Are the claims supported by verified, relevant observations?

status_dimensions.name: Publication Readiness
status_dimensions.question: Is the investigation reproducible and adequately communicated?

nodes.label: Load
nodes.blurb: Resolves the investigation and builds the member set from the spec's own studies — member-scoped, so an undeclared study can never leak into the cycle. Reads YAML, writes nothing.

nodes.label: Project
nodes.consumes: authored knowledge/argument (H/AI) merged over derived (D); runs[].outcomes; behavior_tests; relation edges
nodes.produces: the bundle: knowledge, argument, narrative, audit, gates, open_calls, validations, suggestions, signals, revision_proposals, viz_proposals, capability_gaps
nodes.blurb: The pure core. Projects one full cycle under the merge rule — authored wins, derived fills. The validators leave scientific_judgment null: the engine asserts no scientific truth, only consistency. For an evidence-complete study the coded roll-up leaves unassessed, the knowledge projection attaches a derived candidate verdict (candidate_source: derived) from gate_status + findings — a proposal surfaced in status, never the authored verdict and never closing a criterion; a human promotes it with set-verdict.

nodes.label: Reconcile
nodes.produces: {ledger, summary, by_study} — verified / provisional / contradicted / unsupported
nodes.blurb: Classifies every finding by provenance and rolls each study up by its worst finding. VERIFIED requires the cited run completed AND observed matches the computed value within tolerance — a study with no runs.db can never be verified.

nodes.label: Plan
nodes.produces: classified CandidateActions (REPAIR / RESOLVE / REVISE / EXTEND), dependency-ordered
nodes.blurb: Recasts the frontier into a scored, ordered portfolio: repair prerequisites first, then resolve by discrimination, then extend. Entirely frontier-driven — with no hypotheses nothing is discriminable.

nodes.label: Design
nodes.produces: an ExperimentDesign (disjoint-band or expected-information) — or None
nodes.blurb: Discriminates a study's competing hypotheses. First tries a fully-disjoint numeric-band pair; with none, it falls through to the expected-information (EIG) scorer, which ranks the candidate regimes and picks the most-separating one — or abstains (None) when no experiment is informative. Conditional: the scientific content is authored; the function reformats it, adds control detection, and commits a decision rule.

nodes.label: Build
nodes.produces: capability catalog; content-addressed mv: ids, parent-linked
nodes.blurb: Groups composites by path and gives each a token-based capability signature. A novel mechanism with no registered synonym routes to BUILD and fires the capability gap. bind_model_versions stamps each arm with an mv: id (run knobs dropped from the hash) and parent-links children to the model that produced prior evidence — so a new mechanism never silently overwrites the old.

nodes.label: Grading
nodes.blurb: The ONE path that reads run data. Grades every behavior_test against the run's store (byte-identically to the workbench) and writes the computed_outcomes block the roll-ups read computed-first. This is what makes a refutation — and therefore the generative loop — fire on a computed result, not an authored label.

nodes.label: Evaluate
nodes.consumes: per-study support logs + the prior evaluation_snapshot
nodes.blurb: Picks a favored hypothesis and a status (supported / provisionally-supported / contested / unresolved / gated). A settled flip on VERIFIED evidence mints a FindingCandidate — a pending nomination, not yet a Discovery. On a refutation, diagnose_refutation decides whether the model or the hypothesis was wrong, steering which child Growth seeds. (The legacy detect_discoveries path is retired.)

nodes.label: The Gate
nodes.produces: frontier items; closure boolean; value-ranked opportunities; executor plan
nodes.blurb: One function frontier() builds the list of unresolved items; closure(), next_action(), opportunities() and execute_plan() are re-rankings over it. Closure blocks on exactly three kinds. It then dispatches the frontier three ways — Generate (the seam), Grow, and Execute — each gated by one AutonomyPolicy.

nodes.label: emit
nodes.blurb: Maps every frontier opportunity to one of nine typed GenerationRequest kinds and its produces-contract, with a gate of auto or review. Pure, no LLM. A hypothesize request also carries the typed Discrepancy (the measured anomaly / model-disagreement it must explain), so a generated alternative is tied to evidence, not a prompt. The first of the three act-on-the-frontier moves: Generate.

nodes.label: fill
nodes.blurb: The one place an LLM runs. Shells out to $VIVA_FILLER_CMD passing the request on stdin and reading the result on stdout, then validates the shape. No command configured → None, and nothing auto-fills. Honesty rules are non-negotiable: no fabricated numbers, provided-mechanisms-only, interpretation ≠ evidence.

nodes.label: apply
nodes.produces: an atomic, comment-preserving write — or queued_for_review / error
nodes.blurb: Gates each request: review → queued; auto → fill + apply. Routes by kind to a native handler (finding/test/decision writers) or the SkillRegistry adapter (the three authoring contracts hypothesize / critique / acquire_model). Guarded by evidence-authority: an applied artifact can never overwrite a finding's observed or a run's computed_outcomes (interpretation is never evidence). A malformed artifact is recorded error, an abstaining filler queues — never a silent or fabricated apply. The engine never promotes a proposal to a fact.

nodes.label: propose
nodes.blurb: The generative loop. De-duplicates proposals from authored followups, narrative-gap bridges, and decisions_needed — and, crucially, a refuted finding auto-spawns a builds-on child plus a synthesis study folding the refutations into the next discriminating question.

nodes.label: select
nodes.blurb: A thin shim over the one AutonomyPolicy: in autonomous mode every ready proposal launches; in default human_in_the_loop only approved, non-expert-gated proposals do.

nodes.label: seed
nodes.blurb: Authors a run-ready study.yaml that inherits the parent's composite, observables and behavior tests — so the child is runnable and evaluable by construction — then applies the proposal's model_change as the variation under test. This is the apply handler the queued propose_study kind hands off to.

nodes.label: refine
nodes.consumes: a study + the engine's own signals
nodes.blurb: Deepens an existing study from the engine's own signals — replicate count, a parameter sweep, a higher-fidelity composite — rather than from a new question. Where to look harder, not where to look next.

nodes.label: Execute
nodes.blurb: The one phase that changes real state. Picks the first run-ready op, checks readiness, dispatches — or records a 'would-run' and stops when not autonomous. Besides running a study it materializes a design, promotes a seed, builds a missing mechanism, and reopens on feedback. A bounded run (discover investigate) caps it with a Budget (simulation_runs / model_builds / generation_calls) and takes an optional free-text steering goal — the one durable lever on WHAT the engine produces: it rides in every generation request's context and floats on-goal work first (token overlap + kind-intent), while the frontier stays derived from state, never from the prompt. It halts on a typed stop (budget_exhausted / no_informative_experiment / …) and appends every gated action to decision_log[]. Dry by default.

nodes.label: Discovery
nodes.blurb: A FindingCandidate is a pending nomination. A Discovery is minted only by a reviewed promotion — discover review-findings --promote, with novelty and counterevidence assessment — the one path that writes discoveries[]. A candidate diffed against a snapshot from a different grader/resolver VERSION is stale and re-baselined, not mined; a change in measured inputs under the same evaluator is the normal path to a finding, not staleness.

nodes.label: Reopen
nodes.consumes: a compiled scientist request on pending_feedback[]
nodes.blurb: Staged scientist feedback is a first-class cycle move, not a side channel. It surfaces as a pending_feedback frontier item whose op is reopen; the execute phase applies it under the autonomy policy, re-opening the closed investigation and recording the applied id so it is not re-applied. ingest-feedback compiles a reopening YAML into typed, schema-validated actions — no prose inference.

kinds: native — writes the finding's prose slots
queued → the Grow seed op authors it
